messages:
Maya: Morning quick daybreak sync — tiny async rundown from me: yesterday finished the eval harness for the new reranker, found one perf regression in long prompts. blocker: test infra flaked once, need a retry strategy. today: iterate on the batcher tweak and open a tiny PR. @Raj can you sanity-check the canary config?

Sam: What I did — finished the metrics panel for per-route token cost. no blockers. today I'll wire the panel into the console dashboards and add a short tooltip for quantization impact.

Olivia: Yesterday I ran the routing smoke tests against eu-west and saw two 503s during peak. blocker: unclear if it's a model fallback loop or networking. left logs in the incident channel. Today I'll reproduce with traffic replay and add more tracing. @Maya fyi might affect the rollout timeline.

Raj: Quick from infra — checked the canary QPS target you asked about. current config looks safe but we should cap burst to avoid spike-caused fallback. suggested snippet:```yaml
rollout:
  strategy: canary
  canary:
    qps: 40
    burst_limit: 60
    fallback_model: rdx-small-v1
```
I'll post this to the rollout PR.

Ben: I can take the reranker PR review after lunch, ETA 3pm PT. also can help debug the eu-west 503s if Olivia wants pairing. ping me @Ben when you're about to run the replay. :+1:

deploy-bot: deploy/redwood-hosted v2.14.1 to staging succeeded — duration 02:18, check pipeline: https://ci.redwood.ai/9887 :white_check_mark:

Maya: Cool, summary / asks: 1) @Raj add the canary snippet to PR and mention burst cap, 2) @Ben please review reranker PR by 3pm, 3) @Olivia coordinate replay with Ben and drop traces in the incident thread so we can link in the rollout notes. If all green we aim to start a limited rollout this afternoon. tiny checklist: `canary.qps <= 40`, `burst_limit <= 60`, `fallback_model set`. I'll update the roadmap ticket with ETA 1700 PT. :rocket:
